name: @barqel/barq-email
description: Transactional email plugin for Barq, powered by nodemailer: SMTP delivery, templates, retries and a batteries-included mailer

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && bun build src/index.ts --external @barqel/barq --external nodemailer --target=node --format=esm --sourcemap=external --outdir dist && tsc --emitDeclarationOnly --declaration --outDir dist
scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun test && bun run build

author: Barq Contributors
